title: Does Low GEX Mean Bigger Moves?
text: Here's a really interesting takeaway. That the first claim is absolutely viable. That low gamma days are followed by larger days. So, if you look at the lowest GEX, the median follow-on move is about 1.4-ish, 1.3 to 1.4. And the highest GEX is essentially half that. And the fact that it's also monotone, which means as we go across this gradient, you'll see that it kind of follows a good behavior pattern. Cuz if it was all over the place, then it would really decrease what we could take away here. So, this is viable. The fact that low gamma days are followed by bigger days. But, don't take that to the bank yet, cuz I'm going to show you a few things later that you will want to be aware of that do better than this effectively.
